heldout_caveat: Held-out AP/precision exceed train-pool figures. A trivial 2-feature logistic-regression baseline shows the SAME pattern (train AP 0.768 vs held-out AP 0.814), and five candidate explanations (base rate, mean/min capacity, edge coefficients, travel time, within-topology rate spread) were checked and ruled out. Most likely explanation: ordinary small-sample variance in which specific entities/scenarios landed positive within only 8 held-out topologies (~1,324 positives), not a topology-level or feature-level artifact. Train-pool figures are used as the conservative estimate for the swap decision below.
swap_rule_result_using_conservative_trai: PASS -- train-pool precision 0.7974 >= 0.75 at recall >= 0.70. use_gnn=true is defensible on the conservative estimate alone. Final swap should still compare lead-time MAE against the deterministic propagator per 03_ML_CONTRACT.md §4.3 before flipping the config flag.
final_reasoning: Deterministic propagator fails the recall>=0.70 bar outright (achieves 0.322), so the GNN wins on recall regardless of the held-out-inflation caveat noted above. On lead-time MAE, GNN beats deterministic by 13-43x even using the CONSERVATIVE train-pool TTC figure (~204s) against deterministic's 3092s -- the margin survives generous discounting for the held-out-pool artifact. Swap decision does not depend on trusting the more favourable held-out-only GNN numbers.
